title: Restore a motor vehicle tradesperson certificate
summary: Learn how to restore your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate online or at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate expired less than 3 months ago, you can restore your certificate online, or at a Service NSW Centre.

You can restore using the details on your renewal form. Once restored, your certificate is considered to have been renewed from the day it expired.

You must not work as motor vehicle tradesperson without a valid certificate.

To find your certificate number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: Can I restore my certificate online?
faqs.a: Yes, if your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate expired less than 3 months ago, you can restore it online or at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What happens if I restore my certificate?
faqs.a: Once restored, your certificate is considered to have been renewed from the day it expired.

faqs.q: How do I find my certificate number and details?
faqs.a: You can visit Verify NSW to find your certificate number and details.
